package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"mime/multipart"
	"net/url"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Upload(form url.Values, v any) any { return v }

func (Server) Helper(m *multipart.Form) any { return m }
